        FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[],$2::uuid[],$3::uuid[],$4::text[],$5::text[],$6::text[],$7::uuid[],$8::int8[])
            AS entry(team_id,item_id,id,user_id,agent_user_id,action,wake_id,permission_revision)
        ON CONFLICT(team_id,item_id,id) DO NOTHING
